item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Some US cities have begun rewarding careful drivers with fewer red lights
item.description: Officials struggled for years to curb high-speed crashes along a residential corridor cutting through Albuquerque, New Mexico, but simply punishing the lead-footed drivers didn’t seem to work. What ultimately did was rewarding the law-abiding ones with fewer red lights. The solution, which the city credits for a dramatic drop in crashes and injuries along one [...]

item.description: New FBI hiring guidance allows some applicants with past prostitution encounters to be evaluated contextually instead of automatically disqualified.
